data.one_liner: A server and browser based MQTT Version 5 client for Dart supporting TCP and WebSockets.
data.what_it_does: Provides an MQTT 5 client implementation for Dart supporting subscription and publishing at all QoS levels, authentication, keep alive, and synchronous connections on both servers and browsers.
use_when: You need to connect a Dart or Flutter application to an MQTT 5 broker via TCP or WebSockets.
You require browser-based or server-based MQTT 5 communication.
avoid_when: You require fully enforced MQTT 5 flow control or subscription identifiers which are not yet implemented.
You only need standard HTTP REST or WebSocket communication without the MQTT protocol.
strengths: Supports both server and browser environments via normal/secure TCP and WebSockets.
Handles connection protocols, keep-alive mechanisms, and QoS message exchanges automatically.
Supports the full MQTT Version 5 message set including user properties and authentication.
weaknesses: Some MQTT 5 protocol features are not yet fully implemented (such as flow control, subscription identifiers, and shared subscriptions).
Receive maximum and topic alias maximum values received in connect acknowledge are not enforced.
